title: Getting to Know You
description: Engaging icebreakers and everyday stories for new acquaintances.
questions: What place on earth feels most like home to you, and what makes it feel that way?
What's a small ritual or habit in your day that brings you unexpected peace?
Do you prefer the mountains, the ocean, or the desert? What draws you there?
What's a food you could eat every single week and never get tired of?
What kind of music do you put on when you need to recharge or lift your mood?
What's the best book, movie, or series you've encountered recently that stayed with you?
What is a hobby or interest you have that most people wouldn't guess?
Do you enjoy cooking or baking? If so, what's your signature dish?
What does your ideal, completely unstructured Sunday afternoon look like?
What's the most fascinating or memorable place you've ever traveled to?
If you could instantly master any creative skill overnight, what would you choose?
What kind of personalities do you find yourself naturally drawn to?
Are you someone who thrives on spontaneous plans, or do you love a clear itinerary?
What's a childhood interest or passion that you still secretly or openly love?
What's the best gift—big or small—you've ever received from someone?
What's something simple in your life right now that you feel deeply grateful for?
If you could spend an entire afternoon in any museum, library, or historic site, which one would it be?
What is your favorite season of the year, and what scent or feeling reminds you of it?
Do you collect anything, intentionally or unintentionally?
What's a job or career path you considered when you were younger that you didn't pursue?
What's a compliment someone gave you that has stuck with you for years?
Are you an early morning bird who loves the quiet sunrise, or a late-night thinker?

What is your go-to comfort food when you've had a long, exhausting day?
What's a small luxury in your daily life that you cherish?
What's something quirky or peculiar about your hometown that you love?
Have you ever had a chance encounter with a stranger that you still remember?
What's a board game, card game, or sport that you always enjoy playing with others?
What kind of weather makes you feel the most alive and energized?
If you could time travel for 24 hours to observe any era in history, where would you go?
What's an item you own that has very little financial value, but immense sentimental value?

What's a podcast, article, or documentary that changed how you view something ordinary?
What is the first thing people usually notice about you when they first meet you?
What is something you enjoy doing that requires intense focus and makes time fly?
If you had to pick a motto or phrase for this chapter of your life, what would it be?
What's a talent or knack you have that doesn't usually come up on a resume?

What's the most unusual coincidence you've ever experienced?
How do you prefer to celebrate personal milestones—quietly or with a crowd?
What is a simple habit you started that significantly improved your everyday life?
What is an unpopular opinion you hold about a popular movie, food, or cultural trend?
What does your favorite Saturday morning routine look like when you have nowhere to rush?
What's a natural wonder—like the northern lights, the Grand Canyon, or bioluminescence—that you dream of seeing in person?
How do you usually recharge your social battery after a busy week of interacting with people?
What is a hidden gem in your current city that you always take out-of-town visitors to?
